_note: Places renamed or re-scoped in Oct 2026. Their old name and narrower scope can survive in other interests' text and in a careless fact sheet, so gemini-author-batch.ts refuses to send one to Gemini unless docs/<interest>-facts.json has a non-empty scope sheet for it (override: --allow-unscoped-renamed), and it drops the other-interest summaries for these places because they still describe the old scope. See memory feedback_renamed_place_old_names.
